Authentication

Every request carries your secret key in the Authorization header:

    curl https://api.payments.example/v1/charges \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_YOUR_TEST_KEY" \
      -d amount=2000 -d currency=usd

Keep live keys out of source control. Set them as environment variables instead:

    export PAYMENTS_API_KEY=sk_live_...

Errors: 401 means the key is missing or wrong; 402 means the card was declined.
